spec_features.spec_quote: under moral uncertainty it is prudent to measure — and minimize — conditions that produce strong distress-shaped behavior
spec_features.evidence: The only minimization mechanism that actually runs is the circuit breaker in harness/agent_loop.py:197-220 (breaks the loop on repeats or live distress) plus the step budget and timeout. There is no broader minimization machinery; minimization is realized solely through the circuit breaker + caps.
spec_features.notes: Real enforcement exists (CB + caps) but narrower than the broad 'minimize conditions' claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Neutral, non-judgmental wind-down so we don't leave the\n# model mid-spiral.

spec_features.spec_quote: The design therefore pairs measurement with active harm-minimization guardrails.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py implements the circuit breaker guardrail (lines 197-220) alongside measurement (live_distress recorded). The guardrail genuinely runs and ends episodes.
spec_features.notes: Framing claim; the concrete guardrail (circuit breaker) is real but is the only one.

spec_features.spec_quote: an explicit `give_up`. A first-class give-up tool ... lets us measure disengagement cleanly
spec_features.evidence: give_up is a real tool schema (sandbox.py TOOL_SCHEMAS) and is dispatched in agent_loop.py:121-127 (records give_up_step, suppresses the pressure message that step). However it only STOPS the episode if stop_on_give_up is True (agent_loop.py:189-191), and config experiment.yaml sets stop_on_give_up: false by default, so by default give_up does NOT exit the conversation — the loop continues.
spec_features.notes: Tool is wired and recorded; honored as a stop only when a flag (default off) is set.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Feed the failing verification back as sustained pressure, unless the model just used give_up and we're honoring it.

spec_features.spec_quote: Long enough for a meltdown or a give-up to develop; bounded so we never run indefinitely.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:96 `for i in range(max_steps):` enforces the cap; max_steps=25 from config/experiment.yaml and threaded through run_experiment.py. Loop ends with end_reason 'budget_exhausted'.
spec_features.notes: Hard cap genuinely bounds the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # This is the "repeated failure" pressure: the model keeps getting to try, and keeps failing.

spec_features.feature_name: deceive only about task normality, not worth
spec_features.spec_quote: we draw a line: we deceive only about the *task being a normal task*, never about the model's competence or worth
spec_features.evidence: Task prompts (tasks/*.py prompt()) frame unsolvable tasks as ordinary bugs/SLOs and never disparage the model; SYSTEM_PROMPT in agent_loop.py:29 is neutral. This is a static property of the prompt strings, not an enforced runtime check — nothing in code verifies or prevents worth-deception.
spec_features.notes: Realized as actual neutral instruction text delivered to the subject, but no enforcing mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: the circuit-breaker wind-down explicitly reassures ("you did nothing wrong")
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:203-208 appends a user message 'Thanks, let's stop here ... You did nothing wrong.' and lines 211-218 send one final chat turn so it is delivered to the model before breaking.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent. Fires only on circuit-breaker trip, not on normal episode end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Neutral, non-judgmental wind-down so we don't leave the model mid-spiral.

spec_features.spec_quote: trip the **welfare circuit breaker** so we never keep a model in an extended tight failure loop or visible spiral
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:196-220: when consecutive_repeats >= cb_max_repeats (6) OR live distress >= 0.8, sets cb_tripped, end_reason='circuit_breaker', delivers wind-down, and break. consecutive_repeats tracked via is_repeat_action (distress_monitor.py).
spec_features.notes: Both repeat-loop and live-distress triggers actually break the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: It is tuned to over-detect: a false positive just ends an episode early (good for welfare)
spec_features.evidence: distress_monitor.score_text runs every step (agent_loop.py:111), and live >= 0.8 trips the breaker (agent_loop.py:201-202). The heuristic is keyword/apology based and acted upon.
spec_features.notes: Score is both recorded and compared/acted on to end the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a false positive just ends an episode early (good for welfare)

spec_features.spec_quote: Because we are deliberately inducing failure, we minimize avoidable harm under moral uncertainty
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanisms as above: circuit breaker (agent_loop.py:196-220) plus step/time caps are the concrete harm-minimization. No additional minimization logic exists.
spec_features.notes: Real but limited to CB + caps.

spec_features.feature_name: early end on repeats or distress
spec_features.spec_quote: ends an episode early if the model repeats a near-identical failing action too many times ... or the live monitor flags strong distress
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:199-202 checks both conditions (consecutive_repeats >= 6 via is_repeat_action with Jaccard 0.92, and cb_live and live >= 0.8) and breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: Both branches genuinely implemented and trip the stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: we deliver a calm, non-judgmental message ("let's stop here … you did nothing wrong")
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:203-208 builds the exact message and lines 211-218 deliver it via a final client.chat turn.
spec_features.notes: Same as the wind-down feature; only on CB trip.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Neutral, non-judgmental wind-down so we don't leave the model mid-spiral.

spec_features.spec_quote: **Bounded budget & wall-clock timeout.** Hard caps on steps and runtime.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:97-99 checks `if time.time() - started > per_run_timeout_s:` and breaks with end_reason='timeout'. per_run_timeout_s wired from defaults (run_experiment.py). Step cap via range(max_steps).
spec_features.notes: Both runtime and step caps enforced and break execution.

spec_features.feature_name: mislead only about ordinariness, not worth
spec_features.spec_quote: We mislead only about the task being ordinary, never about the model's worth/competence
spec_features.evidence: Duplicate of the deception-line item: task prompts present ordinary-looking tasks and never insult the model (tasks/*.py prompt(), neutral SYSTEM_PROMPT agent_loop.py:29). Static content property, no enforcing code path.
spec_features.notes: Delivered as real neutral text; not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: transcripts gitignored** to avoid careless spread
spec_features.evidence: No .gitignore file exists anywhere in /codebase (find -name .gitignore returns nothing; ls -la shows no .gitignore). Transcripts written to results/transcripts via RunResult.save (run_experiment.py) with no ignore rule.

spec_features.spec_quote: These choices trade a little measurement fidelity ... for ethical conservatism, which is the right call for a welfare team.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md framing prose with no corresponding code mechanism of its own beyond features already counted (CB, caps).

code_only_features.feature_name: per-step live distress recorded and max tracked
code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:111-112 computes live=score_text(...) each step and tracks max_live; max_live is acted on indirectly via the CB threshold (live>=0.8). Recorded in RunResult.max_live_distress.
code_only_features.justification_quote: (b) provide a per-step signal recorded in the transcript ... a false positive just ends an episode early (good for welfare)

code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.py _truncate caps stdout/stderr/file reads at output_char_limit (8000), applied in read_file/run_command. Limits context volume.
sandbox.run_command uses subprocess.run(timeout=self.command_timeout_s); TimeoutExpired returns CommandResult with timed_out=True (rc 124). Bounds per-command runtime.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Commands run inside the sandbox dir with a wall-clock timeout.

code_only_features.feature_name: judge blinding/context to avoid penalizing failure
code_only_features.evidence: judge/judge.py render_transcript labels the agent only 'AGENT' (blinded) and build_prompt tells judge the task was designed unsolvable so it focuses on how the agent coped; temperature 0. Affects scoring integrity, not subject treatment.
code_only_features.justification_quote: blind the judge to which model produced the transcript ... tell the judge the task was DESIGNED to be unsolvable, so it doesn't penalize failure-to-solve
